- Pins `@types/d3-dispatch` for compatibility with the 0.18.x TypeScript version

detail.readme:
Excalidraw Editor · Documentation · npm · Blog · Excalidraw+

An open source virtual whiteboard with a hand-drawn style, collaborative and end-to-end encrypted. Sketch diagrams, wireframes or whatever you like at [excalidraw.com](https://excalidraw.com), or embed the editor in your own app with the [`@excalidraw/excalidraw`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@excalidraw/excalidraw) React component. ## Features The Excalidraw editor (npm package) supports: - 💯 **Free and open source**: MIT licensed. - 🎨 **Infinite canvas**: zoom and pan without running out of room, with a minimap to find your way around. - ✍️ **Hand-drawn style**: shapes, arrows and text that look sketched, with a choice of fonts, in light or dark mode. - ⚒️ **Wide range of tools**: rectangle, diamond, ellipse, arrow, line, free-draw, text, sticky notes, frames, web embeds, laser pointer, eraser and more. - ➡️ **Arrows that follow your shapes**: arrow binding, labeled arrows and elbow arrows. - 🔀 **Flowcharts from the keyboard**: Ctrl/Cmd+arrow keys add the next node, Alt+arrow keys move between nodes. - 🧜 **Mermaid diagrams**: paste a Mermaid definition and get shapes you can keep editing, with [Mermaid to Excalidraw](https://github.com/excalidraw/mermaid-to-excalidraw). - 📊 **Charts**: paste spreadsheet data and get a bar, line or radar chart. - 📷 **Images and shape libraries**: drop in images and crop them, and reuse shapes from [public libraries](https://libraries.excalidraw.com) or your own. - 🔍 **Command palette and search**: run any action, or find text in the scene, from the keyboard. - 🖼️ **Export to PNG, SVG and clipboard**: or save the drawing as an `.excalidraw` JSON file, an open format. - 🌐 **Localization (i18n)**: translated by the community. - 🏗️ **Customizable**: props, an imperative API and UI you can extend when you embed it. ## Excalidraw.com The app hosted at [excalidraw.com](https://excalidraw.com) is a minimal showcase of what you can build with Excalidraw. Its [source code](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/tree/master/excalidraw-app) is part of this repository as well, and the app features: - 📡 **PWA support**: works offline. - 🤼 **Real-time collaboration**: draw together in the same scene. - 🔒 **End-to-end encryption**: the server can't read what you draw. - 💾 **Local-first**: autosaves to the browser. - 🔗 **Shareable links**: export to a read-only link you can share with others. - ✨ **Generative AI**: text to diagram and wireframe to code. We'll be adding these features as drop-in plugins for the npm package in the future. ## Quick start **Note:** the following instructions are for installing the Excalidraw [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@excalidraw/excalidraw) when integrating Excalidraw into your own app. To run the repository locally for development, please refer to our [Development Guide](https://plus.excalidraw.com/docs/sdk/development). ```bash npm install react react-dom @excalidraw/excalidraw # or yarn add react react-dom @excalidraw/excalidraw ``` To try unreleased changes, use `@excalidraw/excalidraw@next`. ```tsx import { Excalidraw } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw"; import "@excalidraw/excalidraw/index.css"; export default function App() { return (
); } ``` Excalidraw fills its parent, so the parent needs a height. See [installation](https://plus.excalidraw.com/docs/sdk/excalidraw/installation) and [integration](https://plus.excalidraw.com/docs/sdk/excalidraw/integration) for Next.js and other setups. ## Excalidraw+ [Excalidraw+](https://plus.excalidraw.com) is the hosted workspace for teams, built on this editor. Using it also supports the open source project. On top of everything above, you get: - ☁️ **Unlimited scenes, saved to the cloud**: organized in collections, with a dashboard to find them again. - 👥 **Team workspaces**: access management, sharing with edit or view rights, read-only links and embeds. - 💬 **Comments, voice hangouts and screensharing**: discuss a scene where you draw it. - 🎞️ **Presentations**: turn frames into slides, present them live and export them to PDF or PPTX. - ✨ **More AI**: 100 requests a day for text to diagram and wireframe to code, or bring your own key. - 🤖 **MCP server and REST API**: let AI agents and scripts read and edit your scenes. See the [MCP](https://plus.excalidraw.com/docs/mcp) and [API](https://plus.excalidraw.com/docs/api) docs. - 🔌 **Integrations**: bring your scenes into the tools your team already works in. - 🏢 **Enterprise ready**: SSO (SAML or OIDC), admin controls for sharing and AI, and audit logs. - 🔐 **Security**: two-factor authentication that admins can require of every member, encryption at rest and in transit, daily backups and SOC 2 Type 2. See [security and compliance](https://plus.excalidraw.com/security-and-compliance). **[Try Excalidraw+ free for 14 days](https://plus.excalidraw.com)** · [Pricing](https://plus.excalidraw.com/pricing) ## Excalidraw CLI The [Excalidraw CLI](https://github.com/excalidraw/cli) brings Excalidraw to your terminal, scripts and AI agents. It renders drawings and converts Mermaid diagrams on your computer, free and without an account: ```bash npx @excalidraw/cli render drawing.excalidraw --out drawing.png npx @excalidraw/cli mermaid flow.mmd --out flow.excalidraw ``` Log in to Excalidraw+ and it manages your workspace too: scenes, collections, share links and presentations. `excalidraw mcp` gives AI agents the Excalidraw+ drawing tools through the same login. See the [CLI docs](https://plus.excalidraw.com/docs/cli). ## Documentation 📚 **[plus.excalidraw.com/docs/sdk](https://plus.excalidraw.com/docs/sdk)** - [Installation](https://plus.excalidraw.com/docs/sdk/excalidraw/installation) and [integration](https://plus.excalidraw.com/docs/sdk/excalidraw/integration) - [API: props, methods and utilities](https://plus.excalidraw.com/docs/sdk/excalidraw/api) - [Customizing styles](https://plus.excalidraw.com/docs/sdk/excalidraw/customizing-styles) - [FAQ](https://plus.excalidraw.com/docs/sdk/excalidraw/faq) - [Self-hosting the open source editor](https://plus.excalidraw.com/docs/self-hosting/excalidraw-open-source-selfhosting) - [Development](https://plus.excalidraw.com/docs/sdk/development) and [the codebase](https://plus.excalidraw.com/docs/sdk/codebase/json-schema) ## Contributing - Missing something or found a bug? [Report here](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/issues). - Want to contribute? Check out our [contribution guide](https://plus.excalidraw.com/docs/sdk/contributing) or let us know on [Discord](https://discord.gg/UexuTaE). - Want to help with translations? See the [translation guide](https://plus.excalidraw.com/docs/sdk/contributing#translating). ## Integrations - [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@excalidraw/excalidraw) - [Excalidraw CLI](https://github.com/excalidraw/cli) - [Mermaid to Excalidraw](https://github.com/excalidraw/mermaid-to-excalidraw) - [Excalidraw MCP](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw-mcp) - [VScode extension](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=pomdtr.excalidraw-editor) ## Who's integrating Excalidraw [Google Cloud](https://googlecloudcheatsheet.withgoogle.com/architecture) • [Meta](https://meta.com/) • [CodeSandbox](https://codesandbox.io/) • [Obsidian Excalidraw](https://github.com/zsviczian/obsidian-excalidraw-plugin) • [Replit](https://replit.com/) • [Slite](https://slite.com/) • [Notion](https://notion.so/) • [HackerRank](https://www.hackerrank.com/) • and many others ## Sponsors & support If you like the project, you can become a sponsor at [Open Collective](https://opencollective.com/excalidraw) or use [Excalidraw+](https://plus.excalidraw.com/). ## Thank you for supporting Excalidraw [](https://opencollective.com/excalidraw/tiers/sponsors/0/website) [](https://opencollective.com/excalidraw/tiers/sponsors/1/website) [](https://opencollective.com/excalidraw/tiers/sponsors/2/website) [](https://opencollective.com/excalidraw/tiers/sponsors/3/website) [](https://opencollective.com/excalidraw/tiers/sponsors/4/website) [](https://opencollective.com/excalidraw/tiers/sponsors/5/website) [](https://opencollective.com/excalidraw/tiers/sponsors/6/website) [](https://opencollective.com/excalidraw/tiers/sponsors/7/website) [](https://opencollective.com/excalidraw/tiers/sponsors/8/website) [](https://opencollective.com/excalidraw/tiers/sponsors/9/website) [](https://opencollective.com/excalidraw/tiers/sponsors/10/website) Last but not least, we're thankful to these companies for offering their services for free: [![Vercel](./.github/assets/vercel.svg)](https://vercel.com) [![Sentry](./.github/assets/sentry.svg)](https://sentry.io) [![Crowdin](./.github/assets/crowdin.svg)](https://crowdin.com)
